Definition: from a compound of G473 and G236; an equivalent or ransom:--in exchange.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus asks what a man shall give in exchange for his soul, and what shall be given for the world if a man gains it and loses himself. The word is the price paid in return, the thing offered to buy back what was lost.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for an exchange price carries no doctrine of its own; its question is Jesus', that no price can buy back a lost soul.
